{{Top|leg}}
An '''intelligence matrix''' was a component in the [[Juggernaut war droid]] produced by [[Duwani Mechanical Products/Legends|Duwani Mechanical Products]]. Many of the war droids had their matrices removed after they were reprogrammed by [[HK-01]] in the [[Great Droid Revolution]] of [[4015 BBY]].
